about.label: OUR STORY
about.title: FOUNDED
about.description: Lebanese Cycling Club (LCC) was established with a bold vision: to develop world-class cyclists and establish Lebanon as a cycling powerhouse in the Middle East. Starting from humble beginnings, LCC has grown into the nation's premier cycling team, known for discipline, professionalism, and championship-winning performances.
